title_zh: 修订虚构审裁决定的摘要

scenario.label_zh: 修订虚构审裁决定的摘要
scenario.goal_zh: 区分违宪主张与审裁结果并约定按这一区别重写摘要

context_zh: 公共事务课堂使用虚构国家和虚构审裁机构的案例讲义；对话不陈述真实法律或案件。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: My summary says the tribunal found the rule unconstitutional.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: Check the last paragraph. It says the applicant argued that, not that the tribunal agreed.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: You're right. The panel decided to uphold the original decision.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: So we need two separate statements: what the applicant claimed and what the panel decided.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: I'll rewrite it that way and remove the claim that the rule was struck down.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.text: Good. That matches the outcome in this fictional case.
